title: Doll in the Horror Corridor
description: A pale, broken ball-jointed doll with an open screaming mouth and detached limbs poses dramatically in a filthy narrow corridor. Three other damaged, zombie-like dolls with exposed joints shamble forward from the background under harsh fluorescent lighting.
prompt: A broken pale ball-jointed doll with a screaming open mouth and missing limbs dramatically posed in a filthy narrow concrete corridor, red handprints and stains on the decaying walls, three other damaged zombie-like dolls with exposed joints shambling forward in the background, scattered debris and candles on the dirty floor, single overhead fluorescent light creating harsh shadows, eerie and grotesque atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
